HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Wide over-shoulder of a living Korean strongman walking west on a packed-earth ridge road at dusk. LEFT of the attached sheet = Kangrim's mortal face (match exactly); RIGHT board = Samhan rite atmosphere only (ignore its figure poses). He is LARGE, whole, broad-backed, still polite in his body — straw sandals, plain undyed traveler cloth, no grim-reaper black. ONE device: the road as a hard diagonal into pale haze. Behind him tiny giwa roofs and dogs. High-key day paper-white sky with one long cloud-break shaft on his shoulders. Hex #4a4a58 as cool stone bounce only — not a glow. No Japan. No southern seas. No text. No watermark.
